title: From Surveys to Narratives: Rethinking Cultural Value Adaptation in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: Measures cultural values, including the importance of religion, using the World Values Survey (WVS) and detects hate speech targeted at religious groups as a category.
findings: The paper does not present specific findings about religion. Its findings are about cultural adaptation methods in general. Religion is treated as one component of culture, and the study found that adapting models to cultural values (including religious ones) using only survey data can homogenize cultural norms, while augmenting with narrative data improves cultural distinctiveness.
references: 2019. Turkish Spam V01. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI: https://doi.org/10.24432/C5WG7F.
